_note: Arrow wounds on dragons: arrows between scales, through wing membrane, in the hot-blooded flesh beneath. Overrides the arrow source over common.json. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.

levels: , the arrowhead cracking between the scales. A few scales fly loose and {name} snarls, smoke curling from the nostrils.
, the point driving in where the scales are already broken. The hide splits around the shaft and hot blood runs; {name} roars in pain and rage.
, and the arrow sinks deep into the open wound. Dark blood gushes in steaming torrents and {name} bellows, thrashing, wings beating wildly. The air reeks of blood.
, and it is too much. {name} crashes to the ground with a shudder that shakes the earth, arrows bristling from the scales, blood spreading in a vast pool.
